initialization.rule: Each archived independent segment timing is optimized once by target-scene dynamic TOGT MINCO center with fixed author stopping. Each output becomes the shared physical PVAJ initializer for its corresponding free/center SIP run. No selection among seeds before SIP.

finite_solver.finite_failure: stop that seed before verification or adding constraints

selection: Minimum original objective among seeds that converged, passed original SIP, physical collision, ordered-once gate and endpoint checks. Collisions and rejected candidates preserved.
freeze: After this protocol is frozen, no per-course parameter/initializer changes. Failures stay failures.
scene_file_reuse: Original input scene bytes at every call
initialization_cost: shared target time seed parallel wall included in both method elapsed wall, then actual own candidates/check elapsed wall; no sum of candidate CPU times
